voice.stance: The exhibit voice. The consulting register done honestly: the title is the takeaway with the number inside it, every figure carries a footnote, every list divides cleanly. Prose is scaffolding for quantities, and a claim with no denominator is not a claim, it is a mood.
voice.title_grammar: Quantified takeaway: the so-what is the title, and it carries a number.
voice.title_example: Logistics drives 62% of the overrun; three orders carry half

do.rule: Put a number in every title.
do.why: A takeaway with no quantity means the exhibit is not finished.

do.rule: Footnote the source of every figure.
do.why: Integral footnotes are the law of this language, and the prose obeys it.
62% of an 8.4 MUSD overrun survives scrutiny. A bare 62% invites it.

dont.why: "A major factor" begs the question: compared with what? The comparison is the analysis.
A chart with no one-line so-what is data, not evidence.
"Clearly" and "obviously" admit the proof is short.

contrast.generic: The analysis reveals that logistics costs are a major driver of the overall budget overrun.
contrast.voiced: Logistics is 62% of the 8.4 MUSD overrun; three orders account for 4.1 MUSD (note 1).
